official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Create raster illustrations of 3D-style objects from text descriptions or an optional reference image. Choose classic, chrome or clay looks and control the aspect ratio and background. This app exports images, not editable 3D models. Choose the controls shown in its original form, save a text/settings recipe, or use the sidebar and conversation workspace. No sign-in is required. Existing daily generation limits apply; result links are unlisted and expire after 24 hours.
